note: No reason. Shortening a retention is what lets a later prune remove records that were not eligible a moment before; the change carries its own account of intent.
No recordRetention. The request replaces the retention whole; clearing it is spelled `{}`, never by leaving the member out, so that a request that forgot it cannot read as one that meant to clear it.

Changing the key chain's retention policy here. `retentionPolicy` (chained | fromJoin) is fixed at creation because key material either exists for an epoch or it does not; this task changes the record retention only, and an unknown member is refused rather than ignored.
Days as a string. A retention a host applies by arithmetic is a number; `"30"` invites one implementation to parse it and another to refuse it.
